title: Shenzhen's Hidden Botanical Paradise: Exploring Fairy Lake Botanic Garden
description: Xinyi He visited Fairy Lake Botanic Garden, a lush oasis in eastern Shenzhen blending serene lakes, ancient legends, and over 8,000 plant species. Explore themed gardens, rare flora, and tranquil trails near Wutong Mountain. Practical tips included—metro access, affordable tickets, and why it’s a must-visit for nature lovers! 🌿✨
